public_tasks.evidence: 142 released image-bearing CAL tasks; frozen qualification cohort contains 100 distinct task IDs and image files.

relevant_domain_foundation_model.evidence: Official Intern-S1 sources establish a named materials-relevant multimodal scientific foundation model and report MatBench 75.0.
relevant_domain_foundation_model.caveat: No primary source establishes Intern-S1 fit or improvement on OmniMatBench CAL tasks.

harbor.evidence: 100/100 frozen attempts ran in Harbor 0.22.0. Ninety-eight requests matched the complete original image bytes; two trials viewed deterministic source-image crops whose reconstructed PNG hashes exactly match proxy records, proving image use in all 100 attempts.

deepseek_v4_1_flash_binary_accuracy.native_v1: 26/100 = 26.0%; all attempted denominator; Wilson 98.333% CI [17.006%, 37.596%]; cluster bootstrap 98.333% CI [15.556%, 36.458%].
deepseek_v4_1_flash_binary_accuracy.adapter_v2_secondary: All 100 retained attempts regraded; 26/100 under both native-v1 and adapter-v2. Native-v1 remains the precommitted headline.

verifier_false_positive.evidence: Native-v1 accepted 0/142 mechanically definitely wrong, arity-preserving adversarial responses: one for every released image task. This is the complete declared task-probe population, not a claim about every possible wrong response or naturally occurring FP prevalence.
verifier_false_positive.supporting_parser_audit: Adapter-v2 rejected 693/693 artificial invalid cases; that repaired endpoint is separate from native-v1.

verifier_false_negative.evidence: Native-v1 rejected a proven numerically or algebraically identical response on 24/142 distinct released image tasks = 16.901%, strictly above 15%. All 142 tasks are in the declared probe denominator, each task contributes at most one error, and the source-unanswerable case is retained as non-error. Fourteen tasks use exact-Decimal equality; ten use frozen algebraic identities independently confirmed high-confidence by GPT-5.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.6.
verifier_false_negative.finite_population_inference: This enumerates the complete predeclared task-equivalence probe population, not a selected-sample CI: observed 24/142=16.90%; the minimum failure proof is 22/142=15.49%.
verifier_false_negative.scope_caveat: This establishes adversarial equivalence robustness failure across released tasks. It does not estimate the frequency of alternate notation in natural model answers.
verifier_false_negative.preliminary_audit_caveat: The earlier 6/15 selected scientific audit is retained as conditional descriptive evidence only and is not used in this verdict.

stop_reason: Native-v1 fails the complete declared task-equivalence robustness probe gate: 24/142 = 16.901%, above the strict 15% ceiling.
